hooks.name: guard-kiro-secrets-on-save
hooks.description: Inspect .kiro/ config files for hardcoded secrets when they are saved.

action.prompt:
The user just saved a file under `.kiro/`. Before this is committed to GitHub, inspect the file for any hardcoded secrets, API keys, passwords, tokens, private keys, or other sensitive values that should not be in version control.

If you find risky data, briefly explain what was found and ask the user how they'd like to handle it (for example, moving the value to an environment variable or secret store).

If the file looks safe, do nothing.
